decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 31/4/2005, the detached outbuilding extensions to rear of the dwellinghouses, each measuring 7.31m projection, 7.7m wide and 3.9 high with a ridged roof, were not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore require planning permission for the following reason: 

The development fails to represent a structures required for 'a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse' given in the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Informative:
The Council advises separate resubmissions for each of the properties.  Each plan to show an outbuilding totally confined within the curtilage of the property (ie. a space between the common boundary) and deletion of the bathroom.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to rear of both properties
